verdict.rationale: Medusa ships sales-channel and inventory modules that could technically underpin multi-channel selling, and one GitHub blurb notes the framework 'can be used to support... PoS systems,' but this only confirms POS is something developers could build on Medusa's building blocks — there is no evidence of a shipped, first-party point-of-sale application or interface that syncs catalog/inventory/customers with an online storefront out of the box.
